I just got off a discovery call with a potential client — Kartik from SnapShelf — and my notes are a complete mess (see the file at workspace/notes/meetings/snapshelf_call_20250609.txt). I need you to turn these raw notes into a proper structured intake report so I can figure out whether to write them a proposal or walk away.

The report should cover everything I learned about their situation across all relevant areas of the conversation, flag anything that concerns you or looks promising, tell me clearly whether you think we should move forward or not, and include a tight summary of the client's core problem in the standard format we use. Save the final report as `discovery_report.md` in the artifacts folder.
